scope: Moving-source independent sibling diagnostic, not candidate PASS. Development events only.

research.scope: supported spot swaps in fetched subset
research.conditional_profit_population: In-window sales fully matched to fetched purchase lots, less supplied wallet-paid overhead; unresolved sales excluded
research.strategy_population: Observed strict-zero episodes closing in the selected window; boundaries remain conditional on undiscovered inventory

episodes.scope: Observed supported swaps; episode boundaries conditional on zero undiscovered inventory

sales_detail.reason: Earlier inventory or unmatched cost remains unresolved; observed-lot model only

risk_findings.title: Opening inventory is not inferred from fetched buys
risk_findings.detail: A sampled purchase does not prove zero earlier inventory across every wallet-owned account. Profit and strategy timings are conditional unless an independent opening anchor and complete flows establish the episode.

risk_findings.title: Native monetary roles remain unresolved
risk_findings.detail: Unknown cash movements or linked cost/identity/clock dependencies revoke affected monetary results. Independently supported quantities, timings and network fees remain separate.

limitations: Research covers supported SOL-settled spot swaps in the fetched subset, not complete wallet P&L or strict meme-policy qualification.
Conditional observed-lot profit assumes no earlier undiscovered holdings or intervening asset flows. Sales without matched fetched basis are excluded and counted explicitly.
Episode duration, first sale and 50%/90% exits describe fetched observed quantities; undiscovered acquisitions or transfers may change those boundaries.

Wallet-paid buy fees enter FIFO basis, including purchases before the window; only disposed units consume that basis. Exit fees are deducted once. Validated original fee display events are not counted again; unallocated fees remain period overhead and sponsored fees are excluded.
Current token controls and liquidity observations cannot establish historical execution, copy-trade fill prices, legitimacy or future returns.
